execution.entry_reason: The official entry random_model_gen is called. It hardcodes PureSymbolGen, which inherits the no-op SimpleGenerator.post_process (line 180), so the entry itself cannot reach GuidedGen.post_process and GuidedGen is not instantiated anywhere in the pinned repository. After the real entry call, the target is exercised by constructing GuidedGen and running the documented SimpleGenerator.abstract_gen -> GuidedGen.post_process path with max_node_size=0.
